title: Affine to global torsion cohomological dimension reduction
statement: The affine bound in degrees above d + c implies that a finite-type K-scheme of dimension at most d has Subsingleton (H^q(X,F)) for every torsion abelian etale sheaf F and every q with 2*d + c < q.

proof.text: Use zariski_to_etale_core for the inclusion i of Zariski opens into the small etale site, with i(top) terminal. Let P be its sheaf pushforward and Gamma Zariski global sections. Representable flatness and exact sheafification make the left adjoint of P preserve finite limits. The continuous sheaf adjunction therefore makes (P,Gamma) an acyclic composable pair; P followed by Gamma is etale global sections. Use the existing proved AddCommGrpCat-valued Grothendieck-abelian instances, without passing to ringed-site modules.

Prove exactness of a short complex of Zariski sheaves from exactness of sections on every affine open: its map to the kernel is locally surjective, since any section and point admit an affine refinement where a preimage exists. Apply this to the pushed-forward injective resolution. For each affine open U, exact open restriction preserves injectives because its left adjoint is exact extension by zero. Functor.compRightDerivedObjIso and Sheaf.subsingleton_H_iff_isZero_rightDerived identify the section-complex homology with H^n(U,F|U). The upperStar/restriction isomorphism and preservation of torsion allow hAffine to kill it for n>d+c. The dimension inequality is topologicalKrullDim_subspace_le; the affine open over the field is locally of finite type and quasi-compact. Consequently R^n P(F)=0 above d+c, without a stalk-colimit calculation.

The finite-type quasi-compact scheme over the field is Noetherian. Use the existing proved source theorem TopCat.Sheaf.subsingleton_H_of_topologicalKrullDim_lt from WeilConjectures.Topology.Sheaves.GrothendieckVanishing. Its coefficient and space universes coincide, so first replace the underlying topological space by ULift at universe u+1. The homeomorphism induces an equivalence of open categories and hence sheaf categories, preserving Noetherianity, quasi-sobriety and the dimension bound. The derived global-sections comparison across this exact equivalence, using Functor.compRightDerivedObjIso, transports the vanishing back to AddCommGrpCat.{u+1}-valued sheaves on X. Thus R^p Gamma(R^n P(F))=0 whenever d<p, for all n. This uses the source theorem directly rather than the separately stated Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.ZariskiDimensionBound theorem.

Apply the existing proved Functor.isZero_rightDerived_comp_of_lt_add from WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.Vanishing to the two bounds d and d+c. Arithmetic gives d+(d+c)<q from 2*d+c<q. Transport the resulting zero derived functor along the equality P followed by Gamma = etale sections at i(top), then apply Sheaf.subsingleton_H_iff_isZero_rightDerived at that terminal object. No new unproved statement is used or introduced.
